title: The Lord of the Rings
synopsis: Bag End, again. Bilbo's gift is, you'll learn, a curse. The road goes ever on, and you are walking it on small hairy feet.

nodes.text: Eleventy-first. Fireworks. Bilbo vanishes.

choices.consequence: “Notice” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.
“Wave” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Joy.

nodes.text: Gandalf returns with a fireplace and runes.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.
You commit to “Argue.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You sail. The light is kind. Sam, on the dock, raises a hand. You wave back. The sea is, finally, soft.
Sam returns and is, for many years, the mayor. You write the book. The book becomes, eventually, a kind of national story.
Generations read the Red Book of Westmarch. Your handwriting is, in places, smudged. Children copy the smudges, lovingly.
